visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: A Number Pairs with Itself
visualizerParams.problemDescription: For 3, 2, 4 and target 6 the answer is indexes 1 and 2, but the program prints [0,0].

solution.explanation: The current number must be looked up before it is stored. Storing it first lets 3 find itself as its own complement (3 + 3 = 6), but an element may not be used twice.
